tickets.title: Automated Inventory Triggers
tickets.description: Creates a trigger that automatically updates product inventory whenever an order is set to 'completed' or 'cancelled'.
tasks: Creates a trigger that automatically updates product inventory whenever an order is set to 'completed' or 'cancelled'.
learning_objectives: Understand relational database design and querying.
tickets.evaluation: `check_trigger_exists("trg_order_status_update")` `verify_inventory_reduced_on_trigger()` **[A] Correctness (40 pts)**: 40 pts if inventory stock triggers successfully on order updates. **[B] Optimality (30 pts)**: 30 pts if it utilizes bulk joins rather than cursors. **[C] Quality (20 pts)**: 20 pts for clear checking loops of status codes.
common_mistakes: Forgetting semicolons at the end of statements.
Using reserved keywords as column names without backticks.
hints: Review the MySQL documentation for exact syntax.
Test your queries in smaller chunks first.

solution.query.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER trg_order_status_update
    AFTER UPDATE ON orders
    FOR EACH ROW
    BEGIN
      IF NEW.status = 'completed' AND OLD.status != 'completed' THEN
         UPDATE products p
         JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
         SET p.stock = p.stock - oi.quantity
         WHERE oi.order_id = NEW.id;
      END IF;
    END;

tickets.title: Event Scheduler for Archive Logs
tickets.description: Enables the MySQL Event Scheduler and defines a recurring event to purge cart logs older than 30 days.
tasks: Enables the MySQL Event Scheduler and defines a recurring event to purge cart logs older than 30 days.
learning_objectives: Understand relational database design and querying.
tickets.evaluation: `check_event_exists("purge_old_sessions")` `verify_scheduler_active()` **[A] Correctness (40 pts)**: 40 pts if event schedules cleanups correctly. **[B] Optimality (30 pts)**: 30 pts for lightweight, partitioned deleting. **[C] Quality (20 pts)**: 20 pts for clear cron-style event loops.
common_mistakes: Forgetting semicolons at the end of statements.
Using reserved keywords as column names without backticks.
hints: Review the MySQL documentation for exact syntax.
Test your queries in smaller chunks first.

solution.query.sql:
CREATE EVENT purge_old_sessions
    ON SCHEDULE EVERY 1 DAY
    DO
      DELETE FROM session_logs
      WHERE last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY;
